integrity: The threshold is proved by reversible reduction of the published fixed-point equations, an exact quadratic branch analysis, and a polynomial root argument. Numerical replay is corroborative rather than a substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns positive translation-invariant boundary laws for the ferromagnetic order-\(2\) Cayley-tree model and does not classify all Gibbs measures.
The source's later extremality estimates are not reassessed here; only the translation-invariant bifurcation threshold and phase count are addressed.
An equivalent correction could in principle exist in weakly indexed literature; targeted exact-form and alias searches did not locate one.
title: Corrected exact phase threshold for the binary Cayley-tree Blum–Kapel model
